changes: Rebuilt desktop player against current .desktop-player-layout classes and removed reliance on dead div[style] selectors.
Enlarged left transport control square and fixed play/prev/next sizing inside it.
Centered seek timeline in a stable right-side grid and kept utility pill beside the timeline.
Changed play active state so the button keeps the same size and only toggles active-state animation.
Fixed library row grid to selection circle | left-aligned text | actions.
Fixed layout enhancement row detection so selection circles are not marked as text wrappers.
Changed workspace scrolling model so menu bar stays visible and active tab content scrolls internally.
History/current/playlist row lists no longer spill behind the bottom Library bar.
